CollapsibleBar

Бар со сворачиваемой секцией (поиск, баннер) и постоянным футером (полоса вкладок).

Как выглядит

Что это

bar всегда виден, section сворачивается при скролле, footer остаётся прикреплённым под баром. С initiallyCollapsed: true секция скрыта и появляется при протягивании списка вниз (как поиск в мессенджерах). SectionProgress отдаёт степень раскрытия вложенным виджетам.

CollapsibleBar(
  bar: TitleBar(title: 'Chats'),
  section: const GlassSearchBar(fadeWithSection: true),
  sectionHeight: 52,
  initiallyCollapsed: true,
  footer: GlassScrollSegments<int>(value: 0, onChanged: (_) {}, segments: const [GlassSegment(value: 0, label: 'All')]),
  footerHeight: 44,
)

Параметры (из dartdoc)

CollapsibleBar
ПараметрТипПо умолчаниюОписание
barWidgetrequiredThe always visible row (buttons, title). barHeight tall.
sectionWidget?The part that collapses; laid out at sectionHeight and cut to what is left of it. Optional: without it this is a bar with a footer (a strip of tabs) and nothing collapses.
sectionHeightdouble0
barHeightdouble?Default: SwiftUiThemeData.barHeight.
footerWidget?A row under the section that never collapses (a strip of tabs): it sits right under the bar once the section is gone. As part of the bar it is always above the blur and needs no pinned header (nothing to hand over while scrolling).
footerHeightdouble0
initiallyCollapsedboolfalsetrue: the section starts hidden and is revealed by pulling the list down (what messengers do with their search). The kit puts every list in the body at the collapsed offset when it appears (the lists of a pager follow the state the bar is in) and leaves…
glassSpacingdouble14Glass morph distance of the bar row buttons (see LiquidGlassGroup.spacing); the footer and the section are separate layers (a pressed lens must not melt into the buttons above). 0 keeps every bar plate separate.
collapseSectionCollapseSectionCollapse.shrinkHow the section leaves while the list scrolls.

Импорт: import 'package:swiftuikit/swiftuikit.dart';
